image_description: A distorted, AI-generated representation of a black audio cassette tape. The object has the general rectangular shape but suffers from severe structural deformations, including a melting left side that extends into a ribbon-like appendage and a shattered or melted bottom-right corner. The internal spools are visible but geometrically irregular. There is illegible gibberish text in the bottom-left corner resembling a signature or watermark.
